categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies HTTP server binding logic in src/httpserver.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a local credential leak where bitcoind falling back to IPv6-only binding allows a rogue local process on the IPv4 port to intercept plaintext auth cookies sent by bitcoin-cli. As noted in the description, 'A local attacker could capture the cookie and control bitcoind over IPv6', posing a direct authentication security issue in the RPC interface.
